text: In the center of the plaza, the rhythm of everyone's conversations grew more familiar to Leo.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: How are things, Leo? Do you understand them even just a little?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Good. It doesn't need to be perfect right away. What matters is that you're listening.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's alright. Whenever you find it difficult, you can sign SLOW.
On his first evening at the plaza, Leo learned that getting confused is okay. What matters most is asking, listening, and trying again.
